description: A shell script for managing wireless interfaces, security settings, and hostapd configuration on a Raspberry Pi or similar device. It gathers wireless interface info, updates configuration files, and controls Wi-Fi hotspots.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_2G
methods.description: Updates the interface configuration for private Wi-Fi 2G.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_5G
methods.description: Updates the interface configuration for private Wi-Fi 5G.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_2G
methods.description: Updates the interface configuration for public Wi-Fi 2G.

methods.name: update_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_5G
methods.description: Updates the interface configuration for public Wi-Fi 5G.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_2G
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the private Wi-Fi 2G interface configuration.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_private_wifi_5G
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the private Wi-Fi 5G interface configuration.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_2G
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the public Wi-Fi 2G interface configuration.

methods.name: Get_wirelessinterface_public_wifi_5G
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the public Wi-Fi 5G interface configuration.

methods.name: Disabling_XfinityWiFi
methods.description: Disables the specified Wi-Fi interface for Xfinity Wi-Fi feature.
